questions.question: What does linear_beta_schedule(T=200) return?
options: A single beta selected from the image mean
A 200x200 covariance matrix
A length-200 tensor linearly interpolating from beta_start to beta_end
A list of denoised images
questions.explanation: torch.linspace creates one beta for each of the T forward-noising steps.

questions.question: What is the shape of q_sample(x0, t, noise, schedule) relative to x0?
options: One scalar per timestep
The shape of the beta vector
A class-logit matrix
The same shape as x0
questions.explanation: The schedule coefficients are reshaped to broadcast over channels and spatial dimensions, so the noisy sample retains x0's image shape.

questions.question: What target does train_step use for the TinyUNet's MSE loss?
options: The Gaussian noise sampled for the selected timestep
The clean image class label
The original timestep integer as a pixel map
The denoised image from a previous epoch
questions.explanation: The model receives x_t and t and is trained with F.mse_loss(pred, noise), learning to predict the injected noise.

questions.question: What does q_sample combine to construct x_t?
options: x0 divided by the timestep plus a class embedding
sqrt(alpha_bar_t)*x0 plus sqrt(1-alpha_bar_t)*noise
Only the noise tensor, with x0 discarded
The denoiser output plus the beta index
questions.explanation: The closed form uses the cumulative alpha product to mix the clean image and standard Gaussian noise at any selected t.

questions.question: How does sample_ddim differ from sample_ddpm in this code when eta=0?
options: It starts from a clean image instead of Gaussian noise
It trains the U-Net after every reverse step
It uses a shorter chosen timestep sequence and no additional random noise
It never calls the model with a timestep
questions.explanation: DDIM selects a reduced sequence of timesteps; eta=0 sets sigma to zero, making the update deterministic for a given initial noise.

questions.question: Why does TinyUNet receive t as a separate argument?
options: The timestep is the image's class label
t determines the number of output channels
The U-Net cannot process spatial tensors without an integer
The denoiser must condition its prediction on the noise level
questions.explanation: The time embedding is projected into the encoder features so the same network can predict noise at different corruption levels.
